text: The system shall publish processed data resulting from batch ingestion of historical data in standardized formats (SAE J2354, TMDD).
The system shall maintain a long-term archive of all processed data, ensuring that this obligation remains in effect regardless of the specific archiving technology used, including Oracle 10G.
The system shall deliver the generated report via email to the designated recipients when the scheduled time occurs.
The system shall publish processed data in standardized formats using the processed data maintained in the long-term archive as the authoritative source.
The system shall generate statistical summaries from the normalized data stored in the central database.
The system shall provide ad-hoc reporting tools that allow users to query the normalized data stored in the central database.
The system shall provide access to relevant data and functions for all users as appropriate.

The system shall provide ad-hoc reporting tools for authorized users to query and visualize traffic metrics and incident data, with user access controlled by the existing role-based access control policy.
The system shall define the user roles included in 'all users' and document the authorization model for querying archived data.
The system shall allow configuration of new data source types without major software changes to support ongoing real-time data feed operations.
The system shall perform automated data quality checks on data prior to publication in standardized formats.
The system shall provide ad-hoc reporting tools that allow users to define and generate reports using the supported data export formats (CSV, JSON, XML, KML).
The system shall provide all users with access to the web-based interface and its features, subject to authentication and authorization controls as specified in the security requirements.
The system shall allow administrators to configure dynamic caching options for frequently accessed data as part of data source configuration.
